data.long_meaning: Derived from the French name ‘Jean-Baptiste-Marie Vianney', this name signifies ‘Servant of the Lord'. Saint Vianney, also known as the Curé d'Ars, was a Catholic priest who lived in France in the 19th century. The name Vianney carries the meaning “Servant of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Vianney usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes dedication and devotion to God's service.

in_hebrew.name: ואני
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נשמה חדש, מבוסס על שם קדום
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ואני - שם נשמה חדש. השם נבחר להצטיין בשמו של קדוש נוצרי, יוחנן. יוחנן, שטורגיון, סן ואנה - כל אלה הם שמות קדושים הנובעים משם האב, יוחנן (יוחנן: טיווול, עיווול, איווול). השם יוחנן, פירושו 'אלוהים נותן חסד' (בברית החדשה, טיווול ועיווול העיווול).

in_greek.name: Βιαννέι
in_greek.long_meaning: Βιαννέι - ονομασία θρησκευτική. Ο τίτλος Βιαννέι προέρχεται από τον Σαν Βιαννέι, έναν ιαπωνικό ιερέα που ζούσε τον 18ο αιώνα. Τον 19ο αιώνα, ο Σαν Βιαννέι κηρύττεται άγιος από την Καθολική Εκκλησία. Ο Βιαννέι, το όνομα του ιερού ανθρώπου, συνδέεται με την ιδιότητα του να υπηρετεί τον Θεό και την ανθρωπότητα.

in_latin.name: Vianney
in_latin.long_meaning: Vianney - nomen sacramenti. Nomen Vianney a Sancto Ioanne Maria Vianney, sancto qui fuit presbyter, derivatur. Ioannes Maria Vianney fuit presbyter qui fuit in Francia saeculo XIX. Vianney, nomen sancti, significat devotionem et sanctitatem. Sicut Ioannes Maria Vianney, sanctus qui fuit devotus et sanctus, sic nomen Vianney significat devotionem et sanctitatem.

in_english.name: Vianney
in_english.long_meaning: Vianney - name of saint. The name Vianney is derived from Saint John Mary Vianney, a French priest who lived in the 19th century. John Mary Vianney was a devoted and holy priest who was known for his exceptional devotion to God and his people. The name Vianney is associated with the qualities of devotion and sanctity, which are exemplified by Saint John Mary Vianney.

His fame and popularity spread throughout Europe and beyond, drawing pilgrims from all corners of the globe to his modest parish church in Ars-en-Dombes, France. The village, which was once a small, insignificant place, grew in importance as news of the saint's miraculous powers and spiritual gifts reached the world. Saint Vianney's legacy lives on, and his name is synonymous with faith, devotion, and the power of prayer.
data.spiritual_significance: For spiritual significance, the name Vianney is a powerful reminder of the priesthood and the important role that a faithful servant of God can play in the lives of believers. The name carries deep reverence and respect, as Saint Vianney is remembered for his deep faith, dedication to his vocation, and his remarkable ability to help those in need find spiritual guidance and solace. The name Vianney inspires a strong devotion to serving God and a reminder of the importance of humility, dedication, and spiritual discernment in the Christian journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Saint John Vianney, the patron of parish priests, is known for his profound devotion to the priesthood and the Eucharist. His name symbolizes the "wounded vessel" of Christ, who, despite his personal struggles and hardships, offered himself selflessly to God and His people.
